conclusion: For sufficiently general beta every point of each of the four entire mixed curve orbits T1,T2,T4,T6 has full135 completed local ring k[[u,e]]/(e^2), with t=0. All are removed by t-saturation.
limitations: The two mixed surfaces T5,T7 and the binary/flag endpoints are separate.
This does not prove affine finiteness or five-point exhaustion.
